The '''Jedi Enclave'''<ref name="KOTOR2:POGG" /> was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] in the early history of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Haune Tiar]] headed the enclave<ref name="Datacron" /> around [[24,953 BBY]].<ref name="Date">[[Timeline 15: The Jedi Join the Republic]] provides 21,300 BTC as the date when the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' states that the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] began in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], which is 1,347 BTC in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'', so the difference between the calendar based on the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the calendar based on the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] is 3,653 [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. This allows to place the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] joining the Republic in [[24,953 BBY]].</ref> During the [[Dark Wars]],<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> the [[Ossus dueling lens]]es could still be found in the halls of the Jedi Enclave.<ref name="KOTOR2:POGG" />
